=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:1229-1241 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The live hook copy treats every non-passing stamp status as FINDING_STAMP_FAILURES and lacks the template's isinstance(status, str) guard and "no valid status" ask branch.
  WHY: A stamp with a missing or unknown status is classified as context-only, so the push proceeds instead of asking, and an unhashable status raises TypeError that cmd_hook swallows and fails open. Severity is MAJOR in the sources (mapped to high); no reviewer disagreed.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: A stamp with a missing or unknown status asks for confirmation (README); findings are matched on file, code and message without line numbers (PR description).
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py (_hook_findings status handling; _static_findings message handling)
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The fixes (isinstance guard, "no valid status" branch, _STATIC_MESSAGE_LINE_RE) exist only in workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py, and the live copy .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py lacks them. Tests load only the template (tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py:25). Sonnet rated this NIT because the sync-claude-live-copies.yml workflow copies the template after merge. The others rated it MAJOR.
- requirement: When another finding holds the push, the failing-stamp text should not redundantly say "The push was not held for this."
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py hook_decision
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The live copy has no STAMP_FAILURES_NOT_HELD constant and no reason.replace stripping it. The template has both. Severity NIT.
- requirement: Tests cover the hook that runs in this repo's interactive sessions.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py MODULE_PATH (line 25)
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The test module imports the template, not .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py, so nothing exercises the live copy's missing guard, branch, normalisation or stripping. Severity MAJOR.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- (TASK_GAP) Requirement: The README says a stamp "with a missing or unknown status … asks for confirmation". The PR description says lint findings are "matched on file, code and message without line numbers, so moved code still matches".
  Expected change site: .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py (_hook_findings, _static_findings)
  Evidence of absence: The live copy does not exist in this checkout and was changed only by the first-round hunks. Later autofix rounds edited only the template. Until the template is copied over, the live hook lets a stamp with a missing or unknown status through as context-only, a non-string status raises a TypeError that cmd_hook swallows, and raw ruff messages citing line numbers are kept. tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py loads only the template (line 25). The drift is tolerated through pending_template_paths and sync-claude-live-copies.yml, so it is a gap in the interim, not a lasting defect.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py `_STATIC_MESSAGE_LINE_RE` is case-sensitive, so a capitalised "Line N" is not normalised. Suggested fix: add re.IGNORECASE (about 1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- All other categories: NONE. The last-run template changes were judged correct.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
